alignment.classification_hsp: single highest-bitscore HSP per pair; do not stitch partial HSPs

exact_match_definition: identical complete peptide bytes and length; not inferred from rounded alignment identity
competitor_definition: all nine positive and comparator seeds, plus all exported proteins within each reference genome in the reciprocal search
high_similarity_definition: both search directions pass identity, both coverages and evalue; unique best seed and unique within-genome reciprocal protein outside 5 percent near-best range
nanH2_rescue: exact historical CDS on either reference strand only; preserve current overlapping annotation conflict; no imputed intact cohort gene
